storage: local filesystem, isolated temporary synthetic databases
dataset: synthetic people table: integer primary key + distinct synthetic email; no real data
command: MASKRIVER_WP3F_CLI_SCALE=1 MASKRIVER_WP3F_SCALE_DIR=<dir> MASKRIVER_WP3F_CLI_ROWS=10000,100000,1000000 MASKRIVER_WP3F_CLI_REPEATS=3 go test ./cmd/maskriver -run TestCLIStreamingScaleEvidence -count=1 -timeout 60m

method.processes: each sample is a real child CLI process for scan, preview, approve, mask --streaming --apply, validate
method.isolation: fresh source and target copy per sample, fresh RunID, real Ed25519 streaming approval, pre-installed outbox
method.timing: fixture generation and copying are outside timed phases; medians over 3 samples per configuration
method.memory: child VmHWM sampled from /proc/<pid>/status every 50 ms during apply; heap not available for the child
method.repeats: 10k x3, 100k x3, 1M x3 for each of (workers,batch) = (1,64), (4,64), (4,256)

notes: MAXROWBYTES is enforced before materialisation by internal/db PageWithin; this run exercises that path.
peak_rss is a sampled high-water mark, not a p95 or a guarantee.
no MySQL or Windows streaming evidence is claimed.
